name: Swap source asset search and network filter
description: Narrow the Swap source (From) asset picker to owned accounts and tokens matching a search text, a network, or both.

name: Trading temporarily unavailable notice
description: See a full-page notice instead of the Buy, Sell, Swap or Concierge form when that trade type, or all trading, is remotely paused or the device failed an authenticity check.
breadcrumb: Trade > Trading temporarily unavailable notice
desktop_navigation: Trade > Buy, Sell, Swap or Concierge (or, in debug mode, an account's Trade tab with the embedded trade form) while the message-system trading feature flag is off or a device authenticity check failed > warning card replaces the form
